# RavenDB
> RavenDB is a high-performance, ACID-compliant NoSQL document database built for scalability, flexibility,
> high-performance data management, and ease of use. It self-optimizes, supports full-text and spatial
> search, distributed time-series and counters, and runs managed in the cloud,
> on-prem, or on edge devices.
## Getting Started
- [Start Free](https://ravendb.net/start): Begin your journey with RavenDB at no cost.
- [Download](https://ravendb.net/download): Download latest version of RavenDB for installation and/or get a license.
- [RavenDB Cloud](https://cloud.ravendb.net): Start your Database as a Service (DBaaS) in minutes.
## Products
- [Products overview](https://ravendb.net/products): Overview of RavenDB as the NoSQL document database that optimizes itself. It can be run managed in the cloud, on prem, or on the edge.
- [RavenDB Cloud](https://ravendb.net/products/cloud): Enterprise-grade speed, power, reliability, and security with RavenDB Cloud. Fully setup, hosted, and managed for you with 24/7 support.
- [RavenDB On-Prem](https://ravendb.net/products/on-prem): Run RavenDB on a private network or data center while enjoying the exact same features, performance, and user interface as RavenDB Cloud.
- [RavenDB Edge](https://ravendb.net/products/edge): Run a full-featured NoSQL database on edge devices.
## Features
- [Features](https://ravendb.net/features): RavenDB rich feature set, including self-optimizing databases, distributed time-series, full-text search, spatial search, data subscriptions, and distributed counters.
- [Performance](https://ravendb.net/performance): Insights into how well RavenDB performs crucial tasks.
- [Comparison](https://ravendb.net/comparison): RavenDB compared with other databases to understand its advantages.
- [RavenDB vs MongoDB](https://ravendb.net/lp/ravendb-vs-mongodb): A detailed comparison between RavenDB and MongoDB.
